Pick TE-chimeric transcript(s) for a gene

Source: R/utils.R
pick_chimeric_tx.Rd

Selects TE-chimeric transcript(s) associated with a given gene. Input can be either a precomputed `chi_GTF` from `processGTF()` or a `combineSE` object together with TE annotation. If expression data are provided through `expr` or `combineSE`, matched transcripts are ranked by mean expression.

Usage

pick_chimeric_tx(
  gene,
  chi_GTF = NULL,
  combineSE = NULL,
  te = NULL,
  gene_col = "gene_name",
  assay_name = "FPKM",
  expr = NULL,
  samples = NULL,
  return_all = FALSE,
  minoverlap = 5,
  threads = 8
)

Arguments

gene

Character. Gene name or gene ID to query.

chi_GTF

Optional `GRanges` object generated by `processGTF()`.

combineSE

Optional `SummarizedExperiment` generated by `stringtieCombine()`.

te

Optional `GRanges` TE annotation. Required when `combineSE` is used and `chi_GTF` is not provided.

gene_col

Character. Column used for gene matching. Default is `"gene_name"`.

assay_name

Character. Assay used for expression ranking when `combineSE` is provided. Default is `"FPKM"`.

expr

Optional expression matrix used for ranking chimeric transcripts. Rows should be transcript IDs and columns should be samples.

samples

Optional character or integer vector. Samples/columns used for expression ranking. If `NULL`, all columns are used.

return_all

Logical. Whether to return all matched transcript IDs.

minoverlap

Integer. Minimum overlap passed to `processGTF()`.

threads

Integer. Number of threads passed to `processGTF()`.

Value

A character vector of transcript ID(s), or `NA_character_`.
